interfaces.postconditions: Stores model call usage and cost estimate; scripted cost zero.
interfaces.errorHandling: No measured savings; duplicate call/step behavior requires testing.

interfaces.variability: Use approved synthetic examples, then gate candidate.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Use approved synthetic examples, then gate candidate.

interfaces.signature: gate_skill(name: str, number: int) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Async gate checks real tools, regression, held-out, approval contract and replay; restores trial pointer and stores PASSED or FAILED.
interfaces.preconditions: Missing version raises KeyError; cost reported only; trial isolation from other requests not proven.
interfaces.postconditions: Async gate checks real tools, regression, held-out, approval contract and replay; restores trial pointer and stores PASSED or FAILED.

interfaces.usage: Gate a candidate and inspect all five results before promotion.

interfaces.signature: promote(name: str, number: int) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Makes a PASSED version live; missing version KeyError, other state PermissionError.
interfaces.preconditions: Changes active pointer, influencing future execution.
interfaces.postconditions: Makes a PASSED version live; missing version KeyError, other state PermissionError.
interfaces.variability: Attempt non-PASSED candidate in isolated fixture; expect refusal.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Attempt non-PASSED candidate in isolated fixture; expect refusal.

interfaces.signature: activate(name: str, number: int, reason: str='rolled back by the owner') -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Moves active pointer to stored version; rollback is same call with older number.
interfaces.preconditions: No PASSED check at this function; review all callers and eligibility policy.
interfaces.postconditions: Moves active pointer to stored version; rollback is same call with older number.
interfaces.errorHandling: Potential governance bypass, not confirmed exploit.
interfaces.variability: Verify only authorized known-good rollback in isolated fixture.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Verify only authorized known-good rollback in isolated fixture.

interfaces.semantics: Async retrieval of governed inbox triage then measure and verdict; on WorkspaceError empty quarantine and note.

interfaces.variability: Test unavailable inbox and ensure consumer checks note and evidence.
